pages.title: A quiet night · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine at night in a tall building in New York. Cris wants to sleep early. But loud music comes from the apartment above. The floor shakes with every beat. She does not want to be rude. She walks upstairs and knocks on the door.
“Hi, Ed. Sorry to bother you. Do you have a minute?” says Ed. “Sure. Is something wrong?” says Ed. “The music is a little loud tonight.” says Ed.

pages.title: A quiet night · 3/3
paragraphs: “Okay. I’ll keep it quiet after ten.” says Ed. “That is very kind. Have a nice evening!” says Ed. Ed turns the music down and says sorry again. Cris goes back to her apartment. The building is quiet and calm. She falls asleep in a few minutes. The next day, she leaves a thank-you note. Kind words make good neighbors.
